_readme: Round 5 (coordinator follow-up): the user's own card or wallet named after the merchant ('with card *4521', 'using card ending 4521', 'via Apple Pay', «ببطاقة مدى», «عبر Apple Pay») is not part of the merchant, so a saved rule for the merchant matches. Read by process-ios-sms/merchant_instrument_test.ts (deterministicParse merchant) and app/test/engine/parser/merchant_instrument_test.dart (ParserEngine rawMerchant). merchant = both sides; device / server = that side only where it differs (the server has no 'Payment … to <merchant>' pattern). Synthetic messages only.
